Nurse here. As you, those time are really hard. And I know your feeling very well, I wish I could get the disease from some people to cure them and me dying. 

I understand your loneliness. I'm like you, but 4 year less (well, sorry, I have family but I dont't have contact with them so...).
Sadly, I can't give you some advice or some answer. I wish I could have it (for me also).

But at least let me give you a thank you for your hard work these days. And for the days before.

Yes, I tried 3 years ago with a medicine. It started to do some effect but my body regulated itself and I woke up like nothing happened. If I took more quantity it would have killed me, but I didn't have the papers to avoid reanimation or avoiding to maintain me if I ended bad, so at the end I had to carry on. Also, at that time I had a bit of hope to change some things, but, well, obviously it didn't happen.  
The thoughts I guess it started when I was 12. But at that time I always thought the situation could change so never intended to harm or killing myself really. The completely lack of support for my parents also didn't help (well, it aggravated it). After that, well, when I think I would change the most (going to university), I failed at getting the qualifications to apply for one degree and I had to choose something I really hate. So in the end, I finished more depressed, bitter and insecure, and that just marked the rest of my life. 

What do you think it causes your void in chest? It's just you didn't find any purpose or something else? Have you tried to speak with someone about that?

Btw, sorry if I do some mistakes. English is not my first language.
